topic: The Attention Mechanism: How Transformers Read
target_audience: University students with a basic understanding of computer science

sections.title: The Problem: Context and Ambiguity
lecture_lines: Words change meaning based on surrounding context.
Self-attention weighs importance of every other word.
It connects 'it' to the right antecedent.
animations: Fade in 'The Problem' title in #FFFFFF color.
Display a sentence with ambiguous word 'bank' in #FFFF00.
Highlight 'bank' in #FF0000 and reveal context indicators in #00FF00.

sections.title: The Mechanics: Query, Key, and Value (Q, K, V)
lecture_lines: Queries, Keys, and Values act as retrieval systems.
Query matches Key to calculate attention scores.
Attention scores scale the Value information.
animations: Fade in 'Query, Key, Value' title in #FFFFFF color.
Appear three distinct vectors labeled Q, K, V in #00FFFF.
Animate Q, K, V interaction with a score indicator in #FFFF00.

sections.title: Visualizing the Calculation: Scaled Dot-Product
lecture_lines: Multiply Queries by Keys to get scores.
Divide by root-d_k then apply Softmax.
Multiply weights by Values for output.
animations: Fade in 'Scaled Dot-Product' title in #FFFFFF color.
Show Q dot K calculation resulting in a heat map in #FF00FF.
Apply Softmax function in #00FF00 to normalize weights.

sections.title: Multi-Head Attention: Seeing the Whole Picture
lecture_lines: One attention pass is not enough.
Multi-head attention attends to different information types.
Heads specialize in grammar, semantics, or sentiment.
animations: Fade in 'Multi-Head Attention' title in #FFFFFF color.
Display four parallel attention heads labeled H1-H4 in #FF00FF.
Animate concatenation of heads into a final vector.

sections.title: Application and Conclusion
lecture_lines: They move beyond sequential to parallel processing.
animations: Fade in 'Application and Conclusion' title in #FFFFFF color.
Pulse the final attention map in #FFFFFF color.
